SELECTED_INDEX: 9
CONFIDENCE: 0.68
EXPLANATION: Two strong bands in the triple-bond region indicate two distinct high-frequency vibrations: 2235 cm⁻¹ matches a nitrile ν(C≡N) (GFQ-009), while 2298 cm⁻¹ is consistent with a Raman-active internal alkyne ν(C≡C) (GFQ-010). Candidate 9 uniquely contains both a nitrile and an internal alkyne, explaining the pair of peaks and their relative intensities. The CH stretches at 2937 and 2989 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and the lack of an acetylenic C–H (~3300 cm⁻¹) support an internal alkyne rather than a terminal one. Other candidates with only one nitrile or only alkynes cannot account for both 2235 and 2298 cm⁻¹ simultaneously.
